Carmen (CS): Quick ask from Sentinel Bio procurement: need a one-page SLA summary for legal. They want: MUP definition, p50/p95 latency targets, credit calc + cap, onboarding timeline, and notes on warm-up behavior and multi-region. Renewal check in ~6 weeks. Can @Noah and @Leila confirm numbers so I can draft?
Noah (SRE): Hosted MUP = 99.9% (we refer to it as "monthly uptime percentage"). Typical latency targets: p50=120ms, p95=360ms for standard endpoints. Dedicated commitments: 99.95% MUP; initial model warm-up can push p95 to ~600-800ms for ~30-90min after deploy.
Leila (Solutions): Agreed. Recommend phrase: "Latency SLOs measured on steady-state production traffic; transient deviations during model swaps, cache warm-up, or large-scale traffic shifts are expected and documented in onboarding guidance."
Carmen (CS): Credits: procurement wants a simple formula and a short worked example they can paste into the contract. Keep it procurement-friendly.
Noah (SRE): Use standard proration formula with a cap: ```credit = round(min(0.3, max(0, (SLO_target - observed_MUP) / SLO_target)) * committed_monthly_fee, 2)``` Cap = 30% monthly.
Leila (Solutions): Example to paste: "Committed = $11,000/mo; Target MUP = 99.9%; Observed MUP = 99.6% -> shortfall 0.3% -> credit = min(30%, 0.003/0.999) * $11,000 ≈ $33. Credits applied as invoice credit on the next billing cycle (not cash)."
Devon (AE): Sentinel mentioned concern about bursty nightly jobs. Recommend optional mitigations in the one-pager: reserved concurrency (Dedicated pool), 1-hour pre-warm window, and priority lanes. Note Dedicated lead time = 2-3 weeks.
Carmen (CS): Action items: (1) Noah - paste final monitoring query or dashboard link for MUP; (2) Leila - draft one-pager + small table Hosted vs Dedicated with p50/p95 and credit cap; (3) Devon - add add-on bullets + pricing ranges. I'll send to procurement by Friday EOD.
Noah (SRE): Metric name confirmed: "monthly uptime percentage (MUP)". Example PromQL for 30d window: `sum_over_time(up{service="inference"}[30d]) / (30*24*3600)`. I'll create a dashboard snapshot and share link. Note: multi-region customers receive per-region SLOs; aggregated reporting available but credits apply per-region unless contract specifies otherwise.
Leila (Solutions): Drafting now. Suggested onboarding timeline (compact): Day 0: kickoff & API keys; Day 1: integration + smoke tests; Day 3: canary + perf tuning; Day 7: scale to steady-state. Optional accelerated 3-day ramp if we schedule pre-warm.
NotifyBot: Reminder scheduled — ping thread participants 2024-07-02T10:00:00Z to finalize one-pager.
Carmen (CS): Perfect. Please add final snippets into the shared doc: https://redwood.docs/sentinel/sla-draft by Thursday 12:00 PT. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
